fusions.name: Breaching Chop
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. You rush up to 6 tiles to it and chop for 18 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Hatchet Flight
fusions.desc: Looses 3 hatchets in a spread, each dealing 3 damage, with 30% more critical chance against a target that has not yet been wounded.

fusions.name: Sawtooth Rush
fusions.desc: Increases your slashing damage by 35% for 12 seconds, and your movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Blood in the Water
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
